prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait background texture for a fantasy handheld compass game UI. Reference 1 is the current UI for material and layout context only. Reference 2 is the current overbusy silver texture to redesign. Generate ONLY the uninterrupted silver chassis artwork, no controls, map, holes, buttons, lettering, gold, jewels, borders or black void. Portrait aspect ratio 390:844. Direction A: QUIET QUICKSILVER. Liquid silver dragon anatomy abstracted into broad flowing polished pewter ribbons, two subtle dragon profiles emerging along the outer lower side edges, smooth satin silver in the central top 15% and lower 40% where actual instruments will overlay. Broad sweeping curves frame the middle circular map area (center x50%, y33%, diameter 98% of width), but fill that area with the same metal as it will be occluded. Restrained warm gray silver, soft upper-left illumination, shallow relief, dark charcoal crevices, large shapes readable on a phone. A crafted antique instrument, not feathers or dense leaves. Edge-to-edge silver surface. No UI elements.
